Оба .uid содержат один и тот же uid — дубли. Удаляю старые CamelCase .uid (проверив, что lowercase-близнец с тем же uid существует):

[tool-call bash] {"command":"cd /Users/user/sigil-of-the-unwilling && git ls-files game/ | grep \"\\.uid$\" | grep -E \"/[A-Z]\" | while read f; do lower=$(echo \"$f\" | perl -pe 's/([A-Z])/lc($1)/ge; s/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/$1_$2/g' ); done; echo \"perl approach too crude, doing it properly:\"; git ls-files game/ | grep \"\\.uid$\" | grep -E \"/[A-Z]\" > /tmp/old_uids.txt; wc -l < /tmp/old_uids.txt; cd game && ok=0; bad=0; while read f; do base=\"${f%.uid}\"; name=\"${base##*/}\"; lower=$(echo \"$name\" | sed -E 's/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/\\1_\\2/g; s/([A-Z]+)([A-Z][a-z])/\\1_\\2/g' | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z'); twin=\"${base%/*}/$lower.uid\"; if [ -f \"$twin\" ] && cmp -s \"$f\" \"$twin\"; then ok=$((ok+1)); else bad=$((bad+1)); echo \"NO TWIN: $f -> $twin\"; fi; done < /tmp/old_uids.txt; echo \"ok=$ok bad=$bad\""}
